versions.changelog: Stabilize project-scoped env loading and improve the article illustration workflow.

- Initial release of Chalk Art Image Generator skill.
- Generate chalkboard art and chalk drawings in a strict chalk-drawing style.
- Automates classic workflows: single and batch image generation, style enforcement, and reference image support.
- First use includes a readiness check for dependencies and API key setup; prompts user to resolve missing requirements.
- Uses WeryAI backend with a fixed gateway; default model is Nano Banana 2 (GEMINI_3_1_FLASH_IMAGE).
- All outputs enforce a pastel-on-blackboard chalk art appearance.
